notes.1895: Late Qing boom after the Sino-Japanese war
notes.1900: Turn of the century, Boxer year
notes.1918: End of the First World War
notes.1922: Eve of the great building boom
notes.1937: The classic Bund skyline complete: Sassoon House with its green pyramidal copper roof, the Bank of China tower under construction, Customs House and HSBC dome
notes.1950: First year of the People's Republic
notes.1965: Socialist construction era before the Cultural Revolution
notes.1993: The Oriental Pearl Tower is NEARLY COMPLETE: all three main spheres in place and the pink cladding mostly on, the thin upper spire still being erected with a crane at the very top, some scaffolding remaining at the base
notes.1995: The Oriental Pearl Tower newly opened and standing alone, its pink spheres clean and complete, the last construction hoardings cleared
notes.1997: The Oriental Pearl Tower is finished, its pink spheres complete and standing alone as the tallest thing on the skyline
notes.1998: The Jin Mao Tower NEARLY TOPPED OUT beside the Pearl Tower, its tiered pagoda like crown taking shape with a crane at the summit and scaffolding on the upper floors
notes.2000: The Jin Mao Tower's tiered pagoda-like crown (1999) now stands beside the Oriental Pearl Tower, a forest of construction cranes and new glass office towers filling in Lujiazui, neon-lit tour boats on the river at dusk brightness, mobile phones appearing in tourists' hands
notes.2002: Pearl Tower and the completed Jin Mao stand together
notes.2004: The Oriental Pearl and the completed tiered Jin Mao Tower stand together
notes.2006: The Shanghai World Financial Center UNDER CONSTRUCTION and now well above its neighbours, a slab of steel and concrete frame with tower cranes at its crown, its trapezoid opening not yet formed, beside the Pearl and Jin Mao
notes.2008: The Shanghai World Financial Center, the bottle-opener shaped tower, newly completed as the tallest, beside Jin Mao and the Oriental Pearl
notes.2012: The Oriental Pearl, Jin Mao and the bottle opener SWFC all complete
notes.2013: The Shanghai Tower TOPPING OUT, its twisting form risen to nearly full height with the crown still open steelwork and tower cranes at the summit, standing with SWFC, Jin Mao and the Pearl Tower
notes.2014: Shanghai Tower's twisting form topped out with tower cranes still at its crown, standing with SWFC, Jin Mao and the Oriental Pearl
notes.2015: The Shanghai Tower newly completed, its twisting glass facade finished and cranes gone, forming the four tower group with SWFC, Jin Mao and the Oriental Pearl
notes.2017: The complete four tower skyline: the twisting Shanghai Tower, the bottle opener SWFC, the tiered Jin Mao and the Oriental Pearl, backed by a dense wall of glass towers
notes.2020: The complete modern skyline: the twisting Shanghai Tower, the bottle-opener SWFC, Jin Mao Tower and the Oriental Pearl Tower across the Huangpu River, glass towers packed along Lujiazui
